body.p:
Nova Lake supports up to 1TB memory. With only 10 pairs of MTRRs available and other restrictions such as MTRR settings must be any power of 2 and various boot phases require different mappings, etc. The propose solutions are:
BIOS will only map up to 32GB as WB in BIOS phase (instead of 0-TOUUD)
BIOS must configure 0-TOUUD as WB during BIOS-OS handoff (boot loader code)
